patthana21.31:1.1: dhammaṃ paccayā hetu maggārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetu paccayā. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana21.31:2.1: na hetuṃ na maggahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā hetu maggahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetu paccayā. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana21.31:3.1: na hetuṃ na maggādhipatiṃ dhammaṃ paccayā hetumaggādhipati dhammo uppajjati hetu paccayā. hetuyā tīṇi. na hetu na uppanno
